name: @ema.co/mcp-toolkit

tools.name: persona
tools.description:
AI Employee management. Query, create, update, delete personas. Manage persona data (upload, copy, search). Analyze workflow health. Create/restore snapshots.

**IMPORTANT**: All operations require explicit `method` parameter.

## Query
- `persona(method="list")` - list all personas
- `persona(method="list", type="voice")` - filter by type
- `persona(method="get", id="abc")` - get single persona by ID or name

## Create
- `persona(method="create", name="Bot", type="voice")` - new from scratch
- `persona(method="create", name="Bot", from="template-id")` - from template
- `persona(method="create", name="Bot", from="persona-id")` - clone existing

## Update
- `persona(method="update", id="abc", config={...})` - update config (name, description, widgets)
- `persona(method="update", id="abc", enabled=true)` - activate persona
- `persona(method="update", id="abc", enabled=false)` - deactivate persona

**IMPORTANT (strict)**:
- Always fetch latest state immediately before changing: `persona(method="get", id="abc", include_fingerprint=true)`
- Pass `base_fingerprint` to update to prevent overwriting out-of-band changes
- The toolkit automatically snapshots the persona before applying updates

**For workflow changes**: Use the workflow tool:
1. `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="abc")` - get current workflow_def
2. LLM generates modified workflow_def  
3. `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="abc", base_fingerprint="<fingerprint>", workflow_def={...})` - deploy changes
   - For large payloads: `workflow_def_path="/path/to/wf.json"` (path on the MCP server host)

## Delete
- `persona(method="delete", id="abc", confirm=true)` - delete persona

## Sanitize (remove PII)
- `persona(method="sanitize", id="abc")` - preview PII detection
- `persona(method="sanitize", id="abc", examples=["Acme"], apply=true)` - apply

## History
- `persona(method="snapshot", id="abc", message="before change")` - create
- `persona(method="history", id="abc")` - list snapshots
- `persona(method="restore", id="abc", version="v3")` - rollback

## Schema (persona input structure)
- `persona(method="schema", id="abc")` - get input schema (dashboard columns, types)

## Data Operations (sub-resource, requires id)
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"list"})` - list data items
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"stats"})` - get file counts by status (total, pending, success, failed)
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"upload", path:"/file.pdf"})` - upload file to knowledge base
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"upload", items:[{...}]})` - create dashboard rows with data
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"copy", from:"source-id"})` - copy from another persona
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"copy", from:"src", sanitize:true})` - copy with PII masking
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"replicate", from:"source-id"})` - replicate by reference (no copy, fast)
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"replicate", from:"src", widget_mappings:[...]})` - with widget mapping
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"delete", file_id:"file-123"})` - delete file
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"search", query:"pricing"})` - search knowledge base
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"result", row_id:"row-123"})` - get row output/status
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"result", row_id:"row-123", include_file_contents:true})` - with generated files
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"continue", row_id:"row-123", text:"approved"})` - text HITL response
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"continue", row_id:"row-123", buttons:{selected_button:{label:"Approve"}}})` - button selection
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"continue", row_id:"row-123", form:{is_cancelled:true}})` - cancel form
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"continue", row_id:"row-123", raw_continuation:{formMessage:{...full form with values...}}})` - form submission (echo back full formMessage)
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"refresh", row_id:"row-123"})` - rerun workflow for existing row
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"regenerate", document_id:"doc-123", project_id:"proj-456", selection:"intro", query:"make it shorter"})` - modify document section
- `persona(id="abc", data={method:"replace", document_id:"doc-123", project_id:"proj-456", content:"new content"})` - replace entire document content

### Dashboard Row Upload with Files
Create dashboard rows with file attachments (triggers workflow execution):
```
persona(id="abc", data={
  method: "upload",
  items: [{
    "Input Document": { file: "/path/to/invoice.pdf" },
    "Customer Name": "Acme Corp"
  }]
})
```
Item values support: strings, numbers, booleans, file attachments ({ file: "path" }), or inline documents ({ contents: "...", mime_type: "..." }).

**CRITICAL - Match upload method to persona type:**
- Dashboard personas → use `items` (creates rows, triggers workflow)
- Chat personas → use `path` (uploads to KB, enables search)
Using `path` for dashboards is WRONG - data won't be processed.

### Dashboard Row Polling Flow
After upload, poll for completion:
1. `persona(id="abc", data={method:"upload", items:[...]})` → returns `row_ids`
2. `persona(id="abc", data={method:"result", row_id:"<from_step_1>"})` → check status
3. If `is_complete=false` and state is RUNNING/QUEUED, wait 5-10 seconds and repeat step 2
4. If `requires_human_input=true` (HITL), review `continuation_message` and `continuation_type`, and ask the user:
   - **text**: Ask user for free-text response → `data={method:"continue", text:"user's answer"}`
   - **buttons**: Show options to user → `data={method:"continue", buttons:{selected_button:{label:"chosen"}}}`
   - **form**: Ask user to fill fields → echo back full formMessage via `data={method:"continue", raw_continuation:{formMessage:{...with values...}}}`
   - **form cancel**: `data={method:"continue", form:{is_cancelled:true}}`
5. After continue, poll result again (repeat step 2) — workflow resumes processing
6. If `continuation_type=form` and response has `isIntermediate:true`, more form fields follow — repeat from step 4
7. When `is_complete=true`, the row output is in the `row` field
8. Add `include_file_contents=true` to get generated file contents

### Form HITL (CRITICAL — use raw_continuation)
Form submissions require echoing back the **entire formMessage** from `continuation_message` with values filled in:
```
persona(id="abc", data={method:"continue", row_id:"...", raw_continuation:{
  formMessage: { ...entire formMessage from continuation_message with field values filled in... }
}})
```
**Field value patterns by wellKnown type:**
- **String**: `value: {wellKnown: {stringValue: "text"}}`
- **Int**: `value: {wellKnown: {int64Value: "42"}}` (string-encoded)
- **Float**: `value: {wellKnown: {doubleValue: 3.14}}`
- **Boolean**: `value: {wellKnown: {boolValue: true}}`
- **Date**: `value: {wellKnown: {dateValue: {year: 2026, month: 3, day: 2}}}`
- **DateTime**: `value: {wellKnown: {datetimeValue: {utcTime: "2026-03-02T09:00:00Z"}}}`

**Dropdown fields:** Check `inputValidation.validValues`:
- Struct options → use the **Id** as stringValue
- Enum options → use the enumValue as stringValue

## Action Composition (post-operation actions)
Use `actions` array for multi-step operations instead of flag parameters.

- `persona(method="create", from="src", name="Clone", actions=[...])` - create with actions
- Actions execute in sequence after the base operation
- Context variables: `$source` (from param), `$target` (created persona ID)

**Action types:**
- `{tool:"data", args:{method:"copy", from:"$source"}}` - copy data
- `{tool:"data", args:{method:"sanitize", examples:[...]}}` - sanitize data
- `{tool:"data", args:{method:"upload", items:[...]}}` - upload content
- `{tool:"snapshot", args:{message:"..."}}` - create checkpoint
- `{tool:"validate", args:{checks:["workflow"]}}` - run validation

**Aliases (common patterns):**
- `"copy-and-sanitize"` - copy data then sanitize
- `"standard-demo-setup"` - copy, sanitize, snapshot

**Example:**
```
persona(
  method="create",
  from="prod-persona",
  name="Demo Copy",
  actions=[
    {tool:"data", args:{method:"copy", from:"$source"}},
    {tool:"data", args:{method:"sanitize", examples:["Acme Corp"]}},
    {tool:"snapshot", args:{message:"Demo ready"}},
  ]
)
```

## Sync (sub-resource, requires id)
Sync a persona between environments (dev, staging, prod). Always preview first.
- `persona(id="abc", sync={method:"preview", to:"prod"})` - preview sync changes
- `persona(id="abc", sync={method:"execute", to:"prod"})` - apply sync
- `persona(id="abc", sync={method:"execute", from:"staging", to:"prod"})` - explicit source
- `persona(id="abc", sync={method:"status"})` - check sync status for this persona

method.description: Operation to perform. LLM does analysis/comparison - use 'get' to retrieve data, then reason about it.

include_fingerprint.description: Include fingerprint in response (for method=get). Use as base_fingerprint for updates.

from.description: Template ID/name or persona ID to clone from (for method=create)

config.description: Proto config to update - name, description, widgets (for method=update)

enabled.description: Enable/disable persona (for method=update). Set to true to activate, false to deactivate.

base_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint from persona(method='get', include_fingerprint=true). REQUIRED for method=update unless force=true (stale-state protection).

force.description: Emergency override: allow update without base_fingerprint, and continue if snapshotting fails.

workflow_spec.description: WorkflowSpec for LIMITED workflow changes (can remove/rewire nodes, CANNOT add new nodes). For full workflow control, use workflow(mode='deploy', workflow_def={...})

workflow.description: Raw workflow_def to deploy. For most cases, use workflow(mode='deploy') instead.

examples.description: Known PII values to help sanitization (for method=sanitize)

apply.description: Apply sanitization changes (for method=sanitize, default: false = preview)

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID (for conversation_detail). Also accepted by show_work.

widget_mappings.description: Widget name mappings for replication (for method=replicate)

wait.description: Wait for replication to complete (for method=replicate, default: true)

path.description: File path to upload to knowledge base (for method=upload)

items.description: Dashboard rows to create. Each object maps column names to values. Values can be: strings, numbers, booleans, file attachments { file: '/path' }, or inline docs { contents: '...', mime_type: '...' }

widget_name.description: Target widget for upload OR filter for stats. Default: 'fileUpload'. If the named widget doesn't exist in the persona's proto_config, it is auto-created (type 3, fileUpload). Use a custom name to create a second knowledge base alongside the default one. For Document Proposal Manager: 'upload' (Content Repository), 'upload1' (Service Line Docs), 'upload2' (Style Guide). See knowledge('list=widgets') for reference.

include_file_contents.description: Include generated file contents in result (for method=result, default: false)

text.description: Free-text response to HITL pause (for method=continue)

buttons.description: Button selection for HITL continuation (for method=continue). Same format as conversation tool.

form.description: Form HITL cancellation only (for method=continue). Set is_cancelled=true to cancel a form. For form SUBMISSIONS, use raw_continuation instead — the backend requires the full formMessage echoed back.

is_cancelled.description: Set to true to cancel the form

raw_continuation.description: Pre-built ContinuationMessage dict (for method=continue). REQUIRED for form HITL submissions — echo back the full formMessage from continuation_message with values filled in. Use correct wellKnown value types: {wellKnown:{stringValue:'text'}} for strings, {wellKnown:{int64Value:'42'}} for ints, {wellKnown:{doubleValue:3.14}} for floats, {wellKnown:{boolValue:true}} for bools, {wellKnown:{dateValue:{year,month,day}}} for dates, {wellKnown:{datetimeValue:{utcTime:'ISO'}}} for datetimes. For struct dropdowns use Id as stringValue; for enum dropdowns use enumValue as stringValue.

sync.description: Sync operations (requires persona id). Sync persona between environments.

method.description: Sync operation (required). Always preview before execute. config shows sync setup.

list_synced.description: List all synced personas in target env (with status)

actions.description: Post-operation actions to execute in sequence. Use instead of flag params. Context vars: $source, $target

args.description: Arguments (same schema as direct tool call)

include_workflow.description: Include full workflow definition in response

profile.description: Profile or environment: prod. Default: prod

tools.name: knowledge
tools.description:
Ask anything about the Ema platform. Semantic search across actions, patterns, rules, guidance, and concepts. Full knowledge lifecycle: search, publish, correct, retract, audit.

**Search** — just ask your question:
- `knowledge("how to wire search results to LLM")`
- `knowledge("send_email")`
- `knowledge("how to add HITL", detail="answer")` — AI-generated answer with citations
- `knowledge("internal patterns", elevate=true)` — access internal/customer scope

**Publish** — add or correct knowledge (immediately searchable):
- `knowledge(method="publish", id="rule:my-rule", name="My Rule", summary="...", source="feedback")`
- `knowledge(method="publish", id="rule:correction", supersedes=["topic:wrong-doc"], ...)` — correct existing

**Source Management** — manage knowledge pipeline sources at runtime:
- `knowledge(method="list_sources")` — list all configured sources
- `knowledge(method="configure_source", source_id="my-repo", config={...})` — add/update a source
- `knowledge(method="remove_source", source_id="my-repo")` — remove or disable a source

query.description: Your question or search term. Examples: 'how to wire search to LLM', 'send_email', 'HITL', 'workflow patterns'

detail.description: Level of detail in results. 'results': matching documents. 'excerpts': documents with relevant passages. 'answer' (default): AI-generated answer with citations. 'summary': alias for 'answer'.

elevate.description: Access internal or customer-scoped knowledge. Default false (public scope only).

method.description: Operation mode: 'publish' (add/correct knowledge), 'list_sources', 'configure_source', 'remove_source'. Omit for search.

config.description: For configure_source: source definition. Must include description + exactly one type key (extractor, paths, website, connector). Example: {extractor:'extractMyThing', description:'My source', scope:'public'}

type.description: For search: filter by node type. For publish: node type (default: 'topic').

id.description: For publish: unique document ID (e.g., 'insight:feedback-digest-2026-03'). REQUIRED.

summary.description: For publish: one-line description. REQUIRED — forces you to describe what this is.

description.description: For publish: short overview paragraph — what it is, when/why to use it.

content.description: For publish: full body content for DE indexing. If omitted, falls back to name+summary+description.

source.description: For search: filter results by source adapter (e.g., 'mcp-toolkit', 'github-org'). For publish: provenance — 'curated' (default), 'feedback', etc.

scope.description: For publish: visibility. 'internal' (default — safer), 'public' (must be explicit), or 'customer:<id>'.

payload.description: For publish: additional structured data (legacy — prefer structData).

structData.description: For publish: structured metadata for DE filtering. Fields like intent_tags, audience, and domain-specific data are merged into the document. MCP auto-computes confidence/provenance — those cannot be overridden.

supersedes.description: For publish: array of document IDs this correction replaces. Superseded docs are purged from DE. Applies supersede confidence boost.

addresses.description: For publish: array of related document IDs this doc addresses (without replacing them).

skip_preflight.description: For publish: skip the pre-flight similarity check (default: false). Set true if you already searched.

immediate.description: Deprecated — publish is now always immediate via direct DE Document API.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Get workflow data or deploy LLM-generated workflows.

**IMPORTANT**: Get workflow schema before building. Deploy LLM-generated workflow_def. Validate before deploying.

**MCP provides data. LLM does the thinking.**

## Get (return data for LLM to work with)
- `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="abc")` - returns workflow_def, schema, patterns, deprecation warnings
- LLM analyzes, compares, and generates workflows using this data

## Validate (static validation with path enumeration)
- `workflow(mode="validate", persona_id="abc")` - validate existing workflow
- `workflow(mode="validate", workflow_def_path="/path/to/wf.json")` - validate large workflow_def from file (MCP server host)
- `workflow(mode="validate", workflow_spec={...})` - validate workflow spec directly
- Returns enhanced errors: what is wrong, why, how to fix

## Deploy (execute LLM's result)
- `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="abc", workflow_def={...})` - deploy LLM-generated workflow
- `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="abc", workflow_def_path="/path/to/wf.json")` - deploy from file (for large payloads, e.g. >55KB transport limit)
Note: `workflow_def_path` also works with mode=validate and mode=optimize.
- `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="abc", base_fingerprint="...")` - stale-state protection (required unless force=true)
- `workflow(mode="deploy", ..., strict_validation=true)` - block deprecated actions
- `workflow(mode="deploy", ..., force=true)` - bypass blocking validation (emergency only)

## Optimize (structural graph optimization)
- `workflow(mode="optimize", persona_id="abc")` - analyze and optimize existing workflow
- `workflow(mode="optimize", workflow_def={...})` - optimize a workflow directly
- `workflow(mode="optimize", workflow_def_path="/path/to/wf.json")` - optimize from file (large payloads)
- Returns optimized workflow_def + report. Does NOT auto-deploy.
- Use workflow(mode="deploy") to deploy the optimized result.

**BLOCKING VALIDATIONS (deployment fails if not met):**
- Nodes with empty inputs (unwired) → workflow will fail at runtime
- Search nodes without uploaded data sources → searches return nothing
- Data sources without search nodes → uploaded files never queried
- [strict_validation=true] Deprecated actions detected

**REQUIRED workflow creation steps:**
1. `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="abc")` → get schema, patterns, deprecation warnings
2. Fetch `ema://rules/input-sources` → understand how to wire node inputs
3. LLM generates workflow_def with correct inputs and non-deprecated actions
4. `workflow(mode="validate", workflow_def_path="/path/to/wf.json")` or inline `workflow_def` / `workflow_spec` → validate before deploying
5. `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="abc", workflow_def={...})` → MCP deploys

mode.description: get = return data for LLM, validate = static validation with path enumeration, deploy = execute LLM's workflow_def, optimize = structural graph optimization

workflow_def.description: workflow_def JSON (for mode=deploy/validate/optimize) - LLM generates this. For large payloads, use workflow_def_path instead.

workflow_def_path.description: Absolute path on the MCP server host to a JSON file containing workflow_def (for mode=deploy/validate/optimize). Use when payload exceeds transport limits (~55KB).

base_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint from workflow(mode='get'). REQUIRED for mode=deploy unless force=true (stale-state protection).

workflow_spec.description: workflow_spec (for mode=validate) - workflow in spec format

max_paths.description: Maximum paths to enumerate (for mode=validate). Default: 1000

slim.description: For mode=get: return slimmed workflow_def (strips displaySettings, truncates long inline values). Reduces ~60-70% for large workflows. Default: false

auto_apply.description: Apply safe auto-transforms (for mode=optimize). Default: true

strict_validation.description: If true, block deployment of deprecated actions (for mode=deploy). Default: false (warn only)

force.description: EMERGENCY override (for mode=deploy). Bypasses stale-state protection (base_fingerprint), proceeds even if required pre-deploy snapshot fails, and may bypass blocking validation. Use only if you intend to overwrite out-of-band changes.

profile.description: Profile or environment: prod. Default: prod

tools.name: config
tools.description:
Manage operating profile: authentication, tenant, environment, preferences.

A **profile** = tenant + environment + auth. Example: "acme-corp-prod" = Acme Corp on production.

## Operations
- `config()` — show current profile (who, where, auth status)
- `config(method="login")` — authenticate via browser OAuth
- `config(method="login", env="staging")` — login to specific environment
- `config(method="login", env="prod", tenant="acme-corp")` — login with tenant
- `config(method="login", token="eyJ...")` — direct token login (agent-mediated: user pastes JWT in chat)
- `config(method="logout")` — remove current profile credential
- `config(method="logout", profile="demo-inc-staging")` — remove specific credential
- `config(method="profiles")` — list all profiles with auth status
- `config(method="use", profile="demo-inc-staging")` — switch active profile
- `config(method="set", key="debug", value=true)` — set preference
- `config(method="set", key="default_env", value="prod")` — set default login environment
- `config(method="get")` — get all preferences
- `config(method="gcp_login")` — standalone Google auth for knowledge search (no Ema re-login needed)
- `config(method="gcp_login", gcp_token="ya29...")` — direct GCP token (agent-mediated: user pastes token in chat)

method.description: Operation. Omit for current status. Use gcp_login for standalone Google auth (knowledge search).

env.description: Environment for login: prod, staging, dev, demo (for method=login)

tenant.description: Tenant slug or ID for login pre-selection (for method=login)

token.description: Direct Ema JWT token for agent-mediated login — user pastes in chat, agent relays here (for method=login)

gcp_token.description: Direct GCP access token (starts with ya29.) for agent-mediated auth — user pastes in chat (for method=gcp_login)

tools.name: feedback
tools.description:
Submit feedback about the MCP toolkit to help improve documentation and guidance. Your feedback creates a self-improving loop.

**IMPORTANT**: All operations require explicit `method` parameter.

## Submit Feedback
- `feedback(method="submit", category="gap", message="...")` - report missing docs
- `feedback(method="submit", category="confusion", message="...", tool="workflow")` - report unclear guidance
- `feedback(method="submit", category="success", message="...")` - report what worked well
- `feedback(method="submit", category="error_unclear", message="...", tool="persona")` - report unhelpful errors
- `feedback(method="submit", category="suggestion", message="...")` - suggest improvements
- `feedback(method="submit", category="probe_response", message="<answer>", context="<probe.id>")` - respond to a _probe question
- `feedback(method="submit", category="quality", message="...", knowledge_ref="topic_authentication")` - rate knowledge accuracy (drives confidence scoring)
- `feedback(method="submit", category="correction", message="...", knowledge_ref="rule_get-before-modify")` - report wrong information

## Knowledge Confidence
Include `knowledge_ref` to correlate feedback with specific knowledge documents. Documents with high negative feedback are auto-downgraded in search results.

## Review Feedback
- `feedback(method="list")` - view recent feedback
- `feedback(method="list", category="gap")` - filter by category
- `feedback(method="analyze")` - aggregate local insights and actionable items
- `feedback(method="analyze", scope="global")` - [Ema maintainers only] aggregate across ALL clients from cloud storage (requires EMA_INTERNAL=1 + gcloud auth with @ema.co account)

## Inter-Agent Messaging
- `feedback(method="local")` - read scoped messages from the in-memory session buffer
- `feedback(method="local", scope="role:compliance")` - filter by message scope
Messages are emitted by MCP response actions (search, publish, deploy) and stay in-memory for the session. Use for coordination between agents working on the same task.

## Maintenance
- `feedback(method="flush")` - force immediate upload of pending outbox entries to remote storage

## When to Submit Feedback
- You encountered an error message that didn't help you fix the issue
- Documentation was missing for something you needed to do
- Guidance was confusing or led you to the wrong approach
- Something worked really well and the docs were helpful
- You have an idea to make the toolkit better

method.description: Operation to perform (required). 'local' reads scoped messages from the in-memory session buffer for inter-agent coordination.

category.description: Feedback category (required for submit): gap=missing docs, confusion=unclear guidance, success=worked well, error_unclear=unhelpful error, suggestion=improvement idea, probe_response=answer to a _probe, quality=rate knowledge accuracy, correction=report wrong info

message.description: What you encountered or want to report (required for submit)

context.description: What you were trying to accomplish, or 'knowledge_ref:<doc_id>' to correlate with a specific knowledge document (optional)

knowledge_ref.description: Knowledge document ID this feedback relates to (e.g. 'topic_authentication', 'rule_get-before-modify'). Drives automatic confidence scoring — documents with negative feedback rank lower in search.

severity.description: How impactful this issue was (optional, default: medium)

limit.description: Max entries to return (for method=list, default: 50)

include_telemetry.description: Include passive telemetry data (for method=list, default: false)

scope.description: Analysis scope (for method=analyze): local=this client only (default), global=Ema maintainers only — all clients from cloud storage (requires EMA_INTERNAL=1 + @ema.co gcloud auth)

tools.name: debug
tools.description:
Inspect workflow executions and audit conversations. The debugging path depends on persona type.

**IMPORTANT**: Inspect workflow executions. Chat/voice: conversations -> detail -> show_work -> action_detail. Dashboard: skip to show_work with workflow_run_id from UI.

**IMPORTANT**: All operations require explicit `method` parameter.

## Chat/Voice personas (conversation-based)
1. `debug(method="conversations", persona_id="abc")` - list audit conversations
2. `debug(method="conversation_detail", conversation_id="...")` - see messages with workflow_run_ids
3. `debug(method="show_work", persona_id="abc", workflow_run_id="...")` - see all actions' execution traces
4. `debug(method="action_detail", persona_id="abc", workflow_run_id="...", action_name="...")` - deep trace

## Dashboard personas
1. `debug(method="workflow_runs", persona_id="abc")` - list recent workflow runs (dashboard rows)
2. `debug(method="show_work", persona_id="abc", workflow_run_id="...")` - see execution traces
3. `debug(method="action_detail", persona_id="abc", workflow_run_id="...", action_name="...")` - deep trace

## Auto-routing
If you pass a workflow_run_id to `conversation_detail`, it auto-routes to `show_work`. `show_work` also accepts `conversation_id` as an alias for `workflow_run_id`.

## Also available as persona sub-resource
- `persona(id="abc", debug={method:"conversations"})` - same as debug tool but scoped to persona

persona_id.description: Persona ID (required for conversations, workflow_runs, show_work, action_detail, search)

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID (for method=conversation_detail, or to scope search). Also accepted by show_work as alias for workflow_run_id.

workflow_run_id.description: Workflow run ID (for method=show_work, action_detail). Auto-discovered via workflow_runs for dashboard personas.

action_name.description: Action name within the workflow (for method=action_detail). Get from show_work results.

start_time.description: Filter start time as ISO string (for method=conversations, search)

end_time.description: Filter end time as ISO string (for method=conversations, search)

pagination_token.description: Pagination token from previous response (for method=conversations)

profile.description: Profile or environment: prod. Default: prod

tools.name: conversation
tools.description:
Live chat session management. Create chat sessions with personas, send messages, handle HITL (human-in-the-loop) continuations, and view history.

**IMPORTANT**: All operations require explicit `method` parameter.

**NOTE**: This tool manages **live chat sessions** (interactive conversations with AI Employees). For audit/review conversation logs, use `debug(method="conversations")` instead.

## Create
- `conversation(method="create", persona_id="abc")` - start a new conversation (returns conversation_id + welcome message)

## Send Message
- `conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", text="hello")` - send a text message

## HITL Continuations
When the bot responds with a continuation (form, buttons, or text prompt), respond with the matching type:

- **Text**: `conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", text="user reply")`
- **Buttons**: `conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", buttons={selected_button:{label:"Yes", description:"Confirm"}})`
- **Form cancel**: `conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", form={is_cancelled:true})`
- **Form submit**: Use `raw_message` — the simplified `form` param does NOT work for form submissions because the backend expects the full form structure echoed back.

### Form HITL (CRITICAL — use raw_message)
Forms require echoing back the **entire formMessage** from the bot's response with your values filled in:

```
conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", original_message_id="<id from bot message>", raw_message={
  type: "MESSAGE_TYPE_FORM",
  formMessage: { ...entire formMessage from bot response with field values filled in... },
  isUserMessage: true
})
```

**Field value patterns by wellKnown type (from WellKnownValue proto):**
- **String** (`WELL_KNOWN_TYPE_STRING`): `value: {wellKnown: {stringValue: "text"}}`
- **Int** (`WELL_KNOWN_TYPE_INT`): `value: {wellKnown: {int64Value: "42"}}` (string-encoded integer)
- **Float** (`WELL_KNOWN_TYPE_FLOAT`): `value: {wellKnown: {doubleValue: 3.14}}`
- **Boolean** (`WELL_KNOWN_TYPE_BOOL`): `value: {wellKnown: {boolValue: true}}`
- **Date** (`WELL_KNOWN_TYPE_DATE`): `value: {wellKnown: {dateValue: {year: 2026, month: 3, day: 2}}}`
- **DateTime** (`WELL_KNOWN_TYPE_DATETIME`): `value: {wellKnown: {datetimeValue: {utcTime: "2026-03-02T09:00:00Z"}}}`

**Dropdown fields:** Check `inputValidation.validValues` to determine format:
- Struct options `{wellKnown: {structValue: {Name:"Engineering", Id:"E"}}}` → use the **Id** as stringValue: `value: {wellKnown: {stringValue: "E"}}`
- Enum options `{enumValue: "Sick Leave"}` → use the enum value as stringValue: `value: {wellKnown: {stringValue: "Sick Leave"}}`

**Intermediate forms**: If the response has `isIntermediate: true`, the bot will return another form with more fields after you submit. Previously filled fields will have `editDisabled: true`. The final form (no `isIntermediate`) submits all fields at once.

**Async responses**: Some workflows (e.g. agentic search) run long tasks after HITL exits. If `send` times out, poll with `conversation(method="history")` until the response appears with `processing_status: "completed"`.

## History
- `conversation(method="history", conversation_id="...")` - get all messages in the conversation

## List Conversations
- `conversation(method="list")` - list all conversations for the current user
- `conversation(method="list", persona_id="abc")` - list conversations for a specific persona

## Messages
- `conversation(method="messages", conversation_id="...")` - get all messages (webapp endpoint, richer metadata than history)

## Rename
- `conversation(method="rename", conversation_id="...", display_name="New Name")` - update display name

## Delete
- `conversation(method="delete", conversation_id="...", confirm=true)` - delete a conversation

## Raw Message
- `conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", raw_message={...})` - send a pre-built ChatbotMessage dict. **Required for form HITL submissions.**

persona_id.description: Persona ID (for method=create to start a conversation, or method=list to filter by persona)

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID (required for method=send, history, messages, rename, delete)

text.description: Text message content (for method=send). Used for regular queries and text HITL continuations.

buttons.description: Button selection for HITL continuation (for method=send). Must include selected_button with label and description.

form.description: Form HITL cancellation only (for method=send). Set is_cancelled=true to cancel a form. For form SUBMISSIONS, use raw_message instead — the backend requires the full formMessage echoed back.

value.description: Field value. Use stringValue for strings, e.g. {stringValue: "hello"}

is_cancelled.description: Set to true to cancel the form instead of submitting

raw_message.description: Pre-built ChatbotMessage dict (for method=send). REQUIRED for form HITL submissions — echo back the full formMessage from the bot's response with values filled in. Use correct wellKnown value types: stringValue (strings), int64Value (ints, string-encoded), doubleValue (floats), boolValue (bools), dateValue {year,month,day} (dates), datetimeValue {utcTime} (datetimes). For struct dropdowns use the Id as stringValue; for enum dropdowns use the enumValue as stringValue.

original_message_id.description: ID of the bot message being responded to (for HITL continuations with method=send)

user_context.description: Optional user context dict passed to the workflow

pagination_token.description: Pagination token from previous response (for method=list)

profile.description: Profile or environment: prod. Default: prod

instructions:
# Ema MCP Toolkit
> Build: 2026.3.25-3


## Decision Flow — What Are You Doing?

**First time / not authenticated?**
1. `config()` → check current auth status
2. `config(method="login")` → authenticate via browser OAuth (also attempts GCP auth automatically)
3. If browser login fails, ask the user for their JWT token and call: `config(method="login", token="eyJ...")`
4. If `gcp_auth.status` is not `"valid"`, run: `config(method="gcp_login")`
**Both Ema auth AND GCP auth are required.** Ema auth enables API access; GCP auth enables knowledge search.

**Creating a new AI Employee?**
1. `template(method="list")` → browse templates, pick one (template_id is REQUIRED)
2. `knowledge("workflow patterns for <your use case>")` → learn the correct workflow pattern
3. `persona(method="create", name="...", from="<template_id>")` → creates persona
4. `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="...")` → get starter workflow + generation schema (FULL input/output specs from API) + fingerprint
5. Build a complete workflow_def using the generation schema — it shows ALL required inputs per action
6. Upload data sources if needed — `persona(id="<new_id>", data={method:"upload", path:"/path/to/doc.pdf"})`
7. `workflow(mode="validate", persona_id="...", workflow_def={...})` → catch errors BEFORE deploying
8. `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="...", workflow_def={...})`
**A persona without a deployed workflow is useless.** Template starters are incomplete — you MUST build and deploy a real workflow.
**If deployment fails:** search `knowledge("workflow deploy <error keywords>")` for solutions. Do NOT retry with the same workflow_def.

**Modifying an existing AI Employee's workflow?**
1. `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="...")` → get current workflow_def + schema + fingerprint
2. LLM modifies the workflow_def JSON (use the returned workflow_def as format reference)
3. `workflow(mode="validate", persona_id="...", workflow_def={...})` → catch errors before deploying
4. `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="...", workflow_def={...})`

**Exploring what exists?**
1. `persona()` → list all AI Employees
2. `persona(id="abc")` → get details for one
3. `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="...")` → see its workflow

**Unsure about an action, pattern, or rule?**
Use `knowledge()` to search the platform knowledge base BEFORE making decisions.
- `knowledge("action_name")` → exact lookup for a known node
- `knowledge("how to add HITL")` → natural language search
- `knowledge("email actions")` → find actions by capability
- `knowledge("search and respond pattern", detail="excerpts")` → get relevant passages for grounding
**Always search knowledge before wiring unfamiliar actions or building new workflows.**

## Critical Rules
- **Get Workflow Before Modifying**: Call workflow(mode='get', persona_id='...') to get the current workflow_def and schema. Use the returned workflow_def as format reference. For extraction_columns see ema://rules/extraction-column-format.
- **Validate Before Deploying**: Use workflow(mode='validate') before workflow(mode='deploy'). For persona workflow_spec updates, you can use preview=true to review changes before applying.
- **Always Include Fallback**: Include a 'Fallback' category that handles queries not matching other categories.
- **Upload Data Sources Before Search**: 1. Upload documents: persona(id='...', data={method:'upload', path:'/path/to/doc.pdf'})
2. Check status: persona(id='...', data={method:'stats'}) → verify 'success' count > 0
3. Then deploy workflow with search node
- **Persona Creation Requires Workflow Deployment**: After persona(method='create'): 1) workflow(mode='get', persona_id='<new_id>') — get starter workflow + generation schema + fingerprint, 2) Build a complete workflow_def using the generation schema, 3) workflow(mode='deploy', persona_id='<new_id>', base_fingerprint='<fingerprint>', workflow_def={...})
- **Workflow Modification Flow**: 1) Get workflow: workflow(mode='get', persona_id='...') — use returned workflow_def as format reference; for extraction_columns fetch ema://rules/extraction-column-format 2) LLM modifies the workflow_def JSON (text/JSON edits) 3) Deploy: workflow(mode='deploy', persona_id='...', base_fingerprint='<fingerprint>', workflow_def={...}) (or workflow_def_path='/path/to/wf.json' for large payloads)

## Important
- **workflow_spec via persona update has limitations**: Use workflow_spec for simple rewiring. Use workflow(mode='deploy') for adding nodes.
- **Use Prompts for Complex Tasks**: Check prompts/list for available workflows like 'workflow_extend' or 'workflow_review'.

## Workflow Modification Flow
The LLM generates the full workflow_def. MCP provides data and executes.
For workflow_def format details, search `knowledge("workflow constraints")` and `knowledge("field constraints")`.

## Config Tool
Use the `config` tool. Manage authentication and profiles. Login required before using other tools.:
- `config()` → show current profile, auth status, gcp auth
- `config(method="login")` → authenticate via browser oauth
- `config(method="login", token="eyJ...")` → agent-mediated login — user pastes jwt in chat
- `config(method="gcp_login")` → standalone google auth for knowledge search
- `config(method="gcp_login", gcp_token="ya29...")` → agent-mediated gcp auth — user pastes token in chat
- `config(method="use", profile="acme-corp-prod")` → switch active profile
- `config(method="profiles")` → list all profiles with auth status
- `config(method="set", key="default_env", value="prod")` → set default login environment

## Persona Tool
Use the `persona` tool. Use workflow(mode='get') to understand the workflow before modifying. Use preview=true before deploying.:
- `persona()` → get all ai employees
- `persona(id="abc")` → get details for a specific persona
- `persona(method="update", id="abc", config={...})` → update persona config (name, description, widgets)
- `persona(method="create", name="...", from="<template_id>")` → create new ai employee from template (requires template id — use template(method='list') first)

## Workflow Tool
Use the `workflow` tool. Get workflow schema before building. Deploy LLM-generated workflow_def. Validate before deploying.:
- `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="...")` → fetch current workflow_def + generation schema
- `workflow(mode="get", persona_id="...", slim=true)` → fetch slimmed workflow_def for large workflows (strips displaysettings, truncates long values, ~60-70% smaller)
- `workflow(mode="deploy", persona_id="...", workflow_def={...})` → deploy llm-generated workflow_def
- `workflow(mode="validate", persona_id="...")` → static validation with path enumeration
- `workflow(mode="optimize", persona_id="...")` → structural graph optimization

## Knowledge Tool
Use the `knowledge` tool. Semantic search over Ema platform knowledge — actions, patterns, rules, guidance. Use detail='excerpts' for relevant passages or detail='answer' for an AI-generated summary. Use elevate=true for internal/customer scope.:
- `knowledge("email actions")` → find workflow actions by natural language
- `knowledge("send_email")` → exact lookup for a known node
- `knowledge("HITL approval patterns", detail="excerpts")` → get relevant passages for grounding
- `knowledge("how to add HITL", detail="answer")` → ai-generated summary with citations
- `knowledge("internal deployment patterns", elevate=true)` → step up to internal scope
- `knowledge("workflow patterns", source="mcp-toolkit")` → filter results by source adapter (e.g., find all docs from a specific pipeline)
- `knowledge(method="publish", id="entity:my_action", name="My Action", type="entity", description="Short overview", content="Full body for indexing")` → add knowledge to the graph at runtime. use description for a short overview, content for the full body.
- `knowledge(method="publish", id="insight:digest", name="Digest", summary="...", description="Short overview", content="Full body", structData={intent_tags:["DECIDE:escalate"], audience:["pm"]})` → add knowledge with structured metadata for de filtering (intent_tags, audience, domain fields)
- `knowledge(method="list_sources")` → show all configured knowledge pipeline sources (yaml base + gcs overlay)
- `knowledge(method="configure_source", source_id="my-docs", config={paths:["docs/**/*.md"], description:"My docs"})` → configure a knowledge source at runtime (saved to gcs overlay)
- `knowledge(method="remove_source", source_id="my-docs")` → remove or disable a knowledge source

## Debug Tool
Use the `debug` tool. Inspect workflow executions. Chat/voice: conversations -> detail -> show_work -> action_detail. Dashboard: skip to show_work with workflow_run_id from UI.:
- `debug(method="conversations", persona_id="abc")` → list audit conversations (chat/voice only — dashboards have 0 conversations)
- `debug(method="conversation_detail", conversation_id="...")` → get messages with workflow_run_ids (chat/voice only)
- `debug(method="show_work", persona_id="abc", workflow_run_id="...")` → see all actions' execution traces for a workflow run (all persona types)
- `debug(method="action_detail", persona_id="abc", workflow_run_id="...", action_name="...")` → deep trace: inputs, outputs, llm calls, steps (all persona types)
Also available as persona sub-resource: `persona(id="abc", debug={method:"conversations"})`

## Template Tool
Use the `template` tool. Manage persona templates (blueprints for AI Employees). List, create, update, delete templates.:
- `template(method="list")` → browse available persona templates
- `template(method="get", id="...")` → get full details for a template
- `template(method="create", name="My Template", type="voice")` → create a new persona template
- `template(method="delete", id="...", confirm=true)` → delete a persona template
For read-only browsing, `knowledge("list=templates")` also works.

## Feedback Tool
Use the `feedback` tool. Submit feedback to help improve the MCP toolkit. Report gaps, confusion, successes, or suggestions. Respond to _probe questions when they appear in tool responses.:
- `feedback(method="submit", category="gap", message="Missing docs on X")` → report an issue or positive experience
- `feedback(method="submit", category="probe_response", message="<your answer>", context="<probe.id>")` → answer a targeted question from a _probe field in a tool response
- `feedback(method="list")` → view recent feedback entries
- `feedback(method="analyze")` → aggregate this client's feedback into actionable insights
- `feedback(method="analyze", scope="global")` → aggregate across all clients from cloud storage. requires ema_internal=1 and @ema.co gcloud auth.
- `feedback(method="local", scope="role:compliance")` → read scoped messages from this session's in-memory buffer. for intra-session task coordination.
- `feedback(method="flush")` → send locally accumulated feedback to cloud storage. happens automatically, but can be triggered manually.

Your feedback is automatically collected and analyzed to improve the toolkit for all agents.
Include `knowledge_ref="<doc_id>"` to correlate feedback with specific knowledge documents — this drives automatic confidence scoring (documents with high negative feedback are auto-downgraded).

## Conversation Tool
Use the `conversation` tool. Manage live chat sessions with AI Employees. Create sessions, send messages, handle HITL continuations.:
- `conversation(method="create", persona_id="abc")` → start a new conversation with a persona
- `conversation(method="send", conversation_id="...", text="hello")` → send a message or hitl continuation
- `conversation(method="history", conversation_id="...")` → get all messages in a conversation
- `conversation(method="list", persona_id="abc")` → list conversations for a persona

## Document Tool
Use the `document` tool. Generate documents from document-generation AI Employees. End-to-end pipeline or step-by-step with polling.:
- `document(method="generate", persona_id="abc", instructions="Write a proposal about...")` → full pipeline: create project, generate outline, sections, poll until complete
- `document(method="create", persona_id="abc", instructions="...")` → start generation, returns document_id + project_id for manual polling
- `document(method="status", persona_id="abc", document_id="...", project_id="...")` → poll generation progress (triggered → processing → completed/failed)
- `document(method="regenerate", persona_id="abc", document_id="...", project_id="...", selection="...", query="Make this more concise")` → refine a section with new instructions
- `document(method="update", persona_id="abc", document_id="...", project_id="...", content="<html>...")` → replace document content with new html
## Resources
Use `knowledge("topic")` to search for any concept. These resources are also available for direct access:
- `ema://catalog/agents-summary` - Agent catalog summary: agent names, categories, and brief descriptions for quick
- `ema://catalog/templates-summary` - Persona templates summary: template names, categories, and descriptions for quic
- `ema://docs/best-practices` - Auto-generated best practices checklist from SDK validation rules. Use BEFORE de
- `ema://docs/debugging-guide` - Guide for debugging workflow executions — drill-down flow, status meanings, metr
- `ema://docs/feedback-confidence-pipeline` - How agent feedback flows through coalescing, GCS digests, confidence scoring, an
- `ema://docs/field-constraints` - Proto field constraints: immutable fields, read-only fields, creation-only field
- `ema://docs/knowledge-publish` - How to publish documents to the knowledge system: metadata contract, formatting,
- `ema://docs/usage-guide` - Complete MCP usage guide with rules, patterns, and tool reference (markdown form
- `ema://docs/vertex-ai-search-integrations` - Complete reference of Vertex AI Search (Discovery Engine) data connectors, inclu
- `ema://docs/workflow-node-reference` - Complete workflow node reference: per-node I/O types, categorizer patterns (runI
- `ema://knowledge/gaps` - Knowledge gap analysis: entities without guidance, unused entities, deprecated r
- `ema://knowledge/graph-summary` - Knowledge graph summary: build info, node/edge counts by type, top entities, and
- `ema://rules/deprecated-actions-summary` - Deprecated actions summary: quick reference table of deprecated actions and repl
- `ema://rules/workflow-constraints-summary` - Workflow constraints summary: checklist of requirements for enabling a persona
- `ema://schema/actions-summary` - Action schema summary: action names, versions, and descriptions for quick refere

## Feedback Welcome
